source.title: The Schism
source.description:
I'll cut straight to the chase; the Tyr's Hand enclave is no longer under our control. While we were away at Naxxramas, a force of  hostile crusaders came in from the city of Stratholme and took control of the stronghold. We've been barred entry and any emissaries we send in do not return.

I am loathe to ask for external assistance, but something is very wrong and I don't know if we can reclaim the enclave alone.
source.objective: Speak with Beatrix to learn more about the situation in the Scarlet Enclave at Tyr's Hand and report back to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at Light's Hope Chapel once you've learned more about what is happening.
source.completion:
The developments at Tyr's Hand are... certainly interesting. Abbendis likely dead, Balnazzar returned. While there is part of me that would prefer to sit back and watch the Scarlet Crusade reap what they have sown, I feel that no matter the outcome the Argent Dawn would likely be drawn into conflict. Weakened as we are following the Naxxramas campaign, Lord Tyrosus would prefer our involvement come on our terms rather than having our hand forced.

Also... did you say that Inquisitor Caldoran was there?
